# Best home backup power stations under $1,000

**My top pick is the Anker SOLIX C2000 Gen 2 at about $900.** It has 2,048 Wh, 2,400 W output and a 10 ms UPS switchover, and you can add a battery pack later. Three of the sources I found list it at the same price, and one of them calls it "below recent norm."

## Top picks

| Pick | Capacity / output | Price | Why |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Anker SOLIX C2000 Gen 2** (best overall) | 2,048 Wh / 2,400 W | ~$900 | Expandable (a BP2000 pack doubles it to 4 kWh), UPS, 800 W solar input. About 23 hours on a fridge, CPAP and router. |
| **Bluetti Elite 200 V2** (longest-lasting) | 2,074 Wh / 2,600 W | $899 to $1,199 (see note) | 6,000-cycle LiFePO4 and 1,000 W solar input, but it can't be expanded. |
| **Anker SOLIX F1500** (best value) | 1,536 Wh | $599.99 | Cheapest per Wh among the larger units ($0.39/Wh), with UPS and 600 W solar. It appears in only one source, so confirm the price. |
| **Bluetti AC180** (budget) | 1,152 Wh / 1,800 W | $499 | Most Wh per dollar under $500. About 13 hours on the same load, and it weighs 35 lb. |
| **Jackery Explorer 1000 v2** (lightest) | 1,070 Wh / 1,500 W | $489 at Outbound Power | Weighs 23.8 lb. Solar input is only 400 W, and it can't be expanded. |

## Price conflict on the Elite 200 V2
- Compare Power Stations and Outage Outfitter list it at $899.
- Outage Authority says Bluetti ended its promotion and the price is $1,199, though Amazon had it at $798.99 on Oct 7.
- Check the live price before buying. Under about $900 it's arguably the better battery, and above that the Anker is the better buy.

## Where to buy
I can't browse, so I don't have verified direct product-page links. These pages have the current buy buttons for these models:
- [Outage Outfitter: best under $1,000](https://outageoutfitter.com/best/under-1000/) has Amazon links for the Elite 200 V2, C2000 Gen 2, DELTA 3 Max, Explorer 2000 v2 and AC180.
- [Outage Authority: best for home backup](https://outageauthority.com/roundups/best-power-station-home-backup) has links to Amazon, Anker, Bluetti and Outbound Power. Its Bluetti links carry code AFF5% for 5% off.
- [Compare Power Stations: best under $1,000](https://comparepowerstations.com/best/best-under-1000/) lists all 30 qualifying models with prices from each brand's store.
- [Home Depot: Bluetti Elite 100 V2 (1,024 Wh)](https://www.homedepot.com/p/337557774) is $499 but currently out of stock.

## Caveats
- Outage Outfitter says its specs come from the makers and it hasn't tested the units itself.
- All of these sites earn affiliate commissions.
- Prices change often, so confirm before you buy.
- None of these run a whole house. For 240 V (a well pump or mini-split), the EcoFlow Delta Pro 3 is $2,799, well over your budget.

If you tell me what you need to keep running (fridge, CPAP, window AC) and how long an outage you're planning for, I can narrow this to one pick.
